thread:
Maya Chen: Hey @Priya — can we set up a confidential touchpoint? Jordan started a performance conversation today and I think a lot of it ties back to my executive-function challenges and anxiety. I want to request reasonable accommodations and ask that any formal docs be paused until we do the interactive process. Prefer written notes vs long meetings.

Jordan Patel: Thanks for flagging this, Maya. I raised missed deadlines in Q4 and was worried about impact. I'm absolutely open to accommodations. What would help you right now so we can avoid escalation?

Maya Chen: Thanks, Jordan. Short list: 1) tasks broken into smaller milestones with explicit due dates; 2) written standup where I can reply async; 3) temporary relief from on-call rotation for 6 weeks; 4) optional longer deadlines for project work. Also privacy matters — please don't CC the wider team.

Priya Singh (People Ops): Hi Maya + Jordan — we can start the ADA interactive process. Confidentiality: details will be limited to People Ops, the manager, and HR partner. We can pause any formal PIP or written performance actions for an initial 30-day trial while we evaluate accommodations. Maya, it's helpful (but not required) to share any supporting documentation; we can proceed without it.

Jordan Patel: That's fine with me. I'm okay pausing PIP for 30 days. I can restructure deliverables and do weekly check-ins with clear acceptance criteria.

Maya Chen: Thank you. Weekly check-ins sound good if they're 30 minutes max and have an agenda. Also asking teammates for a one-week on-call swap with Priya's help.

Priya Singh (People Ops): Noted. Proposed immediate accommodations (trial 30 days):

```
- Break tasks into <=3-day milestones
- Replace verbal standup with a single Slack thread update twice/week
- Reduce meeting length to <=30min; agendas required
- On-call swap for 6 weeks (escalations routed to backup)
- Provide a one-page summary of expectations for each deliverable
```

Would you like us to document this as a temporary accommodation? If yes we'll route it to HR and Jordan for sign-off.

Maya Chen: Yes please document. I'll share a short note about my preferred triggers and strategies. I don't want medical details posted, just the accommodations.

Ava Morales (HR): I'll create the case file and own scheduling. We will store the note in the confidential HR folder and limit visibility. Tagging case: HR-2025-87.

case-bot: Case created: HR-2025-87. Owner: Ava Morales (HR). Privacy: restricted.

Priya Singh (People Ops): Next steps: 1) Ava will open the case and send a private calendar invite for an intake meeting (Maya + Priya + Ava) 2) Jordan will adjust sprint board and re-estimate Maya's items 3) We will pause any formal performance documentation for 30 days while trial is active.

Jordan Patel: I'll reassign the first two sprints today and add acceptance criteria inline. Also happy to be the on-call backup if needed.

Maya Chen: Thank you all. Feel much less stressed seeing the plan. Appreciate the privacy. 

Priya Singh (People Ops): We'll follow up with a written accommodation summary after the intake meeting and set a 2-week checkpoint to see how the adjustments are working. If anything changes, ping me directly. :sparkles:
